name: Ivy
description: Pedro Pathing's command-based control flow library, with commands for following Pedro paths.

artifacts.description: Ivy with the Pedro Pathing commands (brings in com.pedropathing.ivy:core)

requires.reason: The Pedro commands in Ivy follow paths with the Pedro Pathing follower.

verification.notes: The documentation installs com.pedropathing.ivy:pedro, which depends on com.pedropathing.ivy:core with the same version. The older com.pedropathing:ivy 1.0.0 is a different, earlier artifact. Artifacts are on Maven Central.
